Name: Tiny Tree Tappers - Now Compatible with Content Patcher
Author: kaistella
Description:
i've been using Eemie's wonderful [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/599/]Just a new map recolor[/url] and i love the way that trees look, but i was irritated by how big the tappers looked on the redesigned trees, so i edited their tapper from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/687/]Darker wood and gold craftables[/url] and made it slightly smaller so that it fits the new trees much better!

﻿special thanks to coldazrael over on the Chucklefish Forums for converting my mod to be compatible with content patcher and the newest update of the game which seems to have rearranged some things in the craftables file.

[size=5]that being said, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] is now required for this mod to work! this way, you can install the mod and have it only overwrite the tree tappers themselves and you may use whatever other craftables you want.[/size]
